The referenced REDIST list does not expressly enumerate these static archive paths; generic static-deployment guidance supplies the reviewed class-level connection. This is an interpretive conclusion, not new Microsoft permission or an unambiguous express REDIST enumeration.

publisherAudience: Visual Studio/SDK developer or permitted application distributor. Complete IDE/SDK product agreements are retained as publisher evidence, not imposed wholesale on ordinary application users.
msvcConditions: Significant primary application functionality, protective distributor/external-end-user agreement, no Preview/Pre-release/Beta runtimes, Microsoft trademark restrictions and the defined Microsoft-source Excluded License restriction. The third-party distributor permission is distinct from ordinary recipient runtime-use rights.
sdkConditions: Significant primary functionality; .lib code distributed only as linker results; protective distributor/external-end-user agreement; valid application copyright; publisher indemnity; preserving Microsoft notices; Microsoft-platform-only distribution; no malicious/deceptive/unlawful program; relevant trademark and Microsoft-source restrictions. Windows Performance Toolkit-specific provisions are not activated by this libucrt input.
sourceObligations: No corresponding-source redistribution duty is asserted for these proprietary object-code inputs. Raw proprietary libraries, selected object bytes, PDB and CRT source are not included.
sanitization: Only public/product-relative archive paths and document URLs are retained; developer account, workstation and private PDB build paths are omitted.
inspectionLimits: Selected-member counts are inspection-time observations of the existing frozen engine, not a fresh source/build receipt. Actual final binary/member binding remains mandatory; ICF contribution spans do not uniquely attribute output bytes.
